source_items.meaning: SAPIENT network comprises autonomous sensing/effector edge Nodes, fusion Nodes, optional message handling; no general equipment schema.
Node is an architecture module; sensor/fusion/effector, Task and status terms differ; BSI M/D/C requiredness differs from proto field syntax.
Sender node_id UUID and optional destination_id; oneof message and 4-byte little-endian frame. BSI content timestamp conflicts with pinned proto send timestamp comment.
Initialization registration/ack/status; task override; GOODBYE reported shutdown, reconnection obligations. Not physical equipment lifetime.
Task and alert requests distinct from acknowledgment/accept-reject; receipt does not independently prove actuation.
Mobile/pointable platform Node declares operationally dependent Nodes; source example does not prove physical part-of.
Child fusion Node can register to parent as edge participant with aggregated capabilities; network/fusion hierarchy not equipment assembly.
Location/LocationList coordinates and datum, optional errors; absent altitude is ambiguous, not zero.
RangeBearing and RangeBearingCone depend on north datum and coordinate units. Omitted elevation differs by message; platform datum undefined in v2.
ENU east/north/up velocity and optional error fields; numeric data type not performed event proof.
AssociatedFile MIME-style type and URL are links to associated resources, not verified retrieval or original provenance.
AssociatedDetection links timestamps, sender/object IDs and relations, including fused detection contributors; not physical part-of.
Standard version file option and custom validation annotations distinct from runtime conformance or formal version negotiation.

source_findings.meaning: Registration declares Node type, ICD version, name, capabilities, status report definition, supported modes and configuration; declarations are not measured state.
Registration precedes other messages; RegistrationAck acceptance and rejection/error distinguished, reconnect/retry 30 seconds if no response; no ISA permission model implied.
Sender Node UUIDv4 reused in messages and destination identity distinct; declared location coordinate system consistency is an interface contract.
NodeDefinition NodeType list spans sensor modalities, human, effectors, mobile/pointable platform and fusion; not manufacturer product type or physical assembly.
Capability category/type with optional value/units describes declared Node function/parameters and uses source-prescribed SI units, not actual observed performance.
Registered heartbeat interval, status output contract and time unit declared; three missed intervals allow a potential loss inference, not confirmed failure or unique ISA min/max intervals.
Coordinate-system/datum declaration supports field-specific types but prohibits mixing UTM and latitude/longitude for one node; actual current position not provided.
Declared future report fields categories SENSOR/POWER/MODE/STATUS, allowed units/values and on-change flag, not a live status sample; a paused task is not physically stationary.
Mode name/type, settle time, latency, scan/tracking, temporary duration, detection/task contract; exactly one default. Declared definition is not selected mode or executed task.
Permanent/temporary/default, fixed/scanning/steerable and none/tracklet/track/re-ID are different type axes; node POINTABLE differs from mode STEERABLE.
PermissionToChange=Required is a registered mode parameter for Nodes requiring source-specified permission, not a verified current authorization grant.

Manufacturer/model mandatory in ConfigurationData; serial/hardware/software version conditional; software serial may denote license; recursive sub_components describe configuration, not proven installed physical containment.

source_findings.meaning: Detection registration declares schema, location error and outputs, not performed observations
Declared report categories DETECTION/TRACK/OBJECT/SIGNAL and named object/track fields are not actual observations
Class confidence definition states whether most-likely or multiple class confidences can be supplied; not validated classification accuracy
PerformanceValue has type, units, typical value and variation; not a direct measured sample or guaranteed detection range
Class/subclass hierarchy and level describe detectable target classifications, not physical sensors or equipment parts
Taxonomy dock classes with scoped namespaces and extensible subclasses; source of object-class extension, not mandatory DIM class hierarchy
Behaviour type/units define detectable target behaviour taxonomy, not an operated device state
Velocity type declares East/North/Up format, datum and SpeedUnits, not actual physical platform velocity or a performed reading
TaskDefinition declares concurrent task count, region definition and command repertoire, not a transmitted Task or completed effect
RegionType advertises area of interest, ignore, boundary, mobile go/no-go with accepted coordinate systems; not a currently applied exclusion-zone state
Class/subclass/behaviour filters and ALL/GT/LT/EQ operators declare acceptable filtering patterns, not processed sensor results
Command declarations have units, completion time and type; legacy name field is removed/reserved in source
Supported commands are scoped differently for sensor and effector Nodes; REQUEST, thresholds, MODE_CHANGE, LOOK_AT, MOVE_TO, PATROL and FOLLOW not executed by registration
LOOK_AT location vs MOVE_TO/PATROL route and FOLLOW detected-object ULID are different tasking semantics; single-target follow limit is source-local
The six RegionType enum values match in pinned registration.proto and task.proto; CommandType enum codes must not be confused with Task.Command oneof wire tags

BSI Table33 labels DetectionPerformance type but pinned registration.proto uses repeated PerformanceValue; exact type naming mismatch held

holds.note: BSI Table43 treats Dock_class_namespace as discretionary with source-defined sapient_core default, but pinned registration.proto annotates field with is_mandatory:true; no silent reconciliation.

BSI Table49 marks concurrent_tasks M and Table55 marks level M; pinned registration.proto represents both as optional without is_mandatory:true. BSI M/D/C must not be conflated with protobuf syntax or code annotations.

BSI Table33 labels detection_performance as DetectionPerformance, pinned registration.proto uses repeated PerformanceValue; Table40 describes its source type, but do not assert same wire-level type name.

BSI Table58 prints CommandType values 7,8,9 under 'Protobuf Field Serial' for MOVE_TO/PATROL/FOLLOW; pinned Task.Command oneof uses field tags 9,10,11. They are separate layers; do not build a converter by treating enum code as field number.

BSI Table59 calls FollowObject.follow_object_id an object ULID; pinned follow.proto uses string is_mandatory:true but no is_ulid annotation. Absence of annotation is not proof source ULID rule is false.

original_table_evidence.meaning: StatusReport wrapper: report_id, system, info, task_id, mode, power, location, field_of_view, coverage, obscuration, status
Power level battery percentage, current source and supply status
Status condition level/type/value and task-related transition/stop meanings
StatusLevel INFORMATION/WARNING/ERROR severity; former enum1 deprecated
StatusType: internal/external faults, illumination, weather, clutter, exposure, PTZ, platform, other
DetectionReport: separate report/object/task IDs, location/confidence, track, prediction, classification, media, signal, provenance and velocity
DetectionReportClassification type with namespace, confidence and subclasses
Nested SubClass type with namespace, confidence, level and sub_class
Signal amplitude, frequency endpoints/centre, pulse duration
DerivedDetection time, fusion node and object identifier from linked original/fused report

source_findings.meaning: Initial status follows RegistrationAck; regular heartbeat with Node UUID and timestamp; three missing registered intervals require fusion-side connection close. 1–60s suggestion is NOTE, not a mandatory universal rate.
StatusReport.report_id is a ULID and distinct from outer sender node_id UUID; System condition and Info NEW/UNCHANGED have separate meanings; an UNCHANGED report contains no new information.

System OK/WARNING/ERROR/GOODBYE denotes source-reported Node state; detailed StatusType/Level denote scoped conditions. These are not verified physical condition or an ISA Operating State equivalence.
Reported mode should match Registration; switching can take settle_time. Table60 labels mode M but §6.3.2.4 says it SHALL be included where multiple modes/states are provided.

Power.level is optional remaining battery percentage 0–100; PowerSource enum identifies node's current supply type, and PowerStatus reports OK/FAULT. No sampled voltage/capacity/runtime or all installed sources.

node_location, field_of_view, coverage, obscuration have different geographic meanings. NEW without field_of_view means lost view; coverage may exceed instantaneous FOV and obscuration describes blind areas.
Status level/value/type and enumerated environmental/platform conditions are scoped reports; paused/stopped task ≠ physical immobility; deprecated StatusLevel enum1 is not current.
One-off status messages SHALL NOT be used; earlier one-off status for alerts is replaced by Alert message, not a stream of StatusReport events.

DetectionReport.report_id ULID identifies the report, object_id ULID identifies detected object (may be unique per detection if no tracking), task_id is task reference; outer node UUID identifies sender, not necessarily physical observer.
Detection location oneof provides Location/RangeBearing; optional detection_confidence 0–1 describes node's reported existence confidence, not accuracy proof or OGC Observation conversion.
PredictedLocation is a future object position in Location/RangeBearing with optional predicted_timestamp; it is not a performed Observation or reliable future event.
TrackObjectInfo type/value/optional error records named metadata about reported track or object, not proof of continuous video track or general ISA Event detector properties.

Object classification and nested subclass type use namespace:value with sapient_core default; optional confidence and behaviour report source assertions, not authenticated tactical identity or a physical equipment taxonomy.
AssociatedFile type/URL references media; URL is not proof that retrieval succeeded or the media came from identified physical observing equipment.

Signal amplitude, start/centre/stop frequency and pulse duration concern detected signal attributes with typically used units, not actual network receive level, transmit power or a universal signal strength ratio.

DerivedDetection references fused results from original reports using timestamp, source node and object identity; linked AssociatedDetection gives reverse connections, not proof original measurement or full transformation lineage.

Current mode M versus conditional mode text; PredictedLocation nested required oneof versus no is_mandatory annotation; DerivedDetection.timestamp M content time versus optional/send-time code comment are distinct source issues.
BSI DerivedDetection.node_id is identity of fusion Node that sourced detection; pinned code comment calls it Node where associated detection originated. Neither is verified physical-sensor identity.

Detected-object report linking permits fused data lineage with contributor IDs but does not automatically identify the original observing physical instrument, exact phenomenon time or an OMS provenance chain.

new_holds.note: BSI Table60 labels StatusReport.mode M; §6.3.2.4 says mode SHALL be included where multiple modes or states are provided. Source text does not establish an unambiguous single-mode applicability rule; pinned status_report.proto sets is_mandatory=true.

BSI Table70 marks the nested PredictedLocation.predicted_location_oneof M, yet pinned detection_report.proto PredictedLocation.oneof has no oneof_options is_mandatory annotation; an optional enclosing prediction_location is different from whether oneof contents must be present when included.

BSI Table77 marks DerivedDetection.timestamp mandatory and describes timestamp of associated detection; pinned detection_report.proto declares optional timestamp without is_mandatory and comments 'UTC timestamp the message was sent'. No silent equivalence to content/send/observed time.

BSI Table77 describes DerivedDetection.node_id as fusion Node source of detection, while pinned DerivedDetection.node_id comment says Node where associated detection originated. The actual original physical observing instrument cannot be inferred from either alone.
